# Tim Burley: Creating great names

> Independent UK brand naming consultant with twenty years leading name development projects for UK and international clients across brands, systems, places and typefaces. Every project is led directly by Tim Burley from strategy brief to trademark filing, typically in 4 to 6 weeks as a fixed-fee engagement.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.timburley.com/): Practice overview, featured work, agency and direct client routes, 5-stage process funnel, and clear boundaries.
- [Brand Naming Portfolio (14 Projects)](https://www.timburley.com/work): Complete reverse-chronological archive of 14 named projects across healthcare, energy, technology, luxury, property, food, public sector and typefaces.
- [Approach, Process & Pitfalls](https://www.timburley.com/process): Four name types, four watchwords (Simple, Memorable, Meaningful, Protectable), five-stage naming funnel (~1,000 names to 1 registered mark), six naming pitfalls, and common buyer questions.
- [About Tim Burley](https://www.timburley.com/about): Background across twenty-five years in agencies and twenty years leading name development.
- [Start a Naming Brief](https://www.timburley.com/brief): Three-minute structured brief for direct clients or partner agencies, or email names@timburley.com directly.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.timburley.com/privacy): Zero cookies, cookieless Vercel Web Analytics, and UK GDPR enquiry handling.
- [Full Markdown Dossier for Agents](https://www.timburley.com/llms-full.txt): Single-file complete reference containing positioning, process, pitfalls, client testimonial, and all 14 case studies with UK IPO trademark links.

## Featured Named Projects

- [Cora (2025, Healthcare)](https://www.timburley.com/work/cora): United Healthshare and Connect Health under one name. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00004121477)
- [Hemiko (2023, Energy)](https://www.timburley.com/work/hemiko): Spun a UK district heating leader out of Pinnacle Group. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00003923225)
- [Corigan (2021, Technology)](https://www.timburley.com/work/corigan): Enterprise SEO platform named with an anagram of Organic. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00003717279)
- [Yomira (2021, Luxury)](https://www.timburley.com/work/yomira): Coined “your ocean” for a luxury superyacht start-up. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00003538653)
- [Grain (2017, Technology)](https://www.timburley.com/work/grain): Full-fibre broadband for new homes, inspired by William Blake. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00003214453)
- [Loka (2015, Energy)](https://www.timburley.com/work/loka): Local, low-carbon district heating for Greenwich Peninsula. (Registered UK trademark: https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/ipo-tmcase/page/Results/1/UK00003069008)

## All Named Projects

- [Cora (2025)](https://www.timburley.com/work/cora): United Healthshare and Connect Health under one name.
- [Hemiko (2023)](https://www.timburley.com/work/hemiko): Spun a UK district heating leader out of Pinnacle Group.
- [Corigan (2021)](https://www.timburley.com/work/corigan): Enterprise SEO platform named with an anagram of Organic.
- [Yomira (2021)](https://www.timburley.com/work/yomira): Coined “your ocean” for a luxury superyacht start-up.
- [Gwallon Keas (2019)](https://www.timburley.com/work/gwallon-keas): A Cornish place name rooted in local stone and land.
- [With Energy (2018)](https://www.timburley.com/work/with-energy): One repeatable community energy brand built to travel.
- [Grain (2017)](https://www.timburley.com/work/grain): Full-fibre broadband for new homes, inspired by William Blake.
- [FS Silas (2016)](https://www.timburley.com/work/fs-silas): An espionage-themed typeface launch for Fontsmith.
- [Loka (2015)](https://www.timburley.com/work/loka): Local, low-carbon district heating for Greenwich Peninsula.
- [Ockery (2015)](https://www.timburley.com/work/ockery): A grounded coastal seafood brand cleared with the .com.
- [Uprising (2014)](https://www.timburley.com/work/uprising): A rebellious challenger brand for gluten-free pastry.
- [Shape Mendip (2013)](https://www.timburley.com/work/shape-mendip): One adaptable hub uniting Mendip’s shared public services.
- [Meddo (2012)](https://www.timburley.com/work/meddo): A calmer take on “meadow” for property maintenance.
- [South West Food & Drink (2004)](https://www.timburley.com/work/swfd): Plain-English regional flagship for South West producers.
